name: tg-income-tax
description: Togo personal income tax reference for the 2026 tax year, covering resident and nonresident individuals, employees, majority managers, pensioners, landlords and independent businesses. Use it for IRPP, salaire imposable, progressive annual bands, family deductions, pension taxation, rental income, sole trader profit and Taxe Professionnelle Unique routing. It explains how to classify income before applying a rate, how to round the annual employment calculation, and when withholding replaces an annual return. The Guide distinguishes general business profit taxation from eligible small enterprise turnover taxation. It links payroll contributions and international withholding to their dedicated Guides and records unresolved procedural details before any filing work.
